In S004, M006 has α=R with its Borel measurable space, μ=λ restricted to I, β=N, and f_i= rho_i^s 1_(J_i), with values in [0,infinity]. The index type is countable; S002-S003 establish Borel measurability, hence μ-almost-everywhere measurability, of each summand. The supplied signature therefore yields exactly the displayed integral/sum equality; neither finite integrals nor additional regularity of the cover is required. The remaining routine applications have their actual conditions and justifications below. There are no E applications.

The Euclidean projections contract distances, so the horizontal sets have admissible diameters and the vertical projections admit the displayed open enclosures. At every t in I the selected horizontal projections cover E, giving the pointwise lower bound. Integrating over a set of length one and applying M006 gives the cover cost plus an error at most epsilon. The nonnegative series calculations remain valid for infinite cost. In the finite-cost case epsilon can be removed with V fixed; the resulting bound for every admissible cover implies the exact infimum inequality. No interchange of an infimum and an integral, or measurability of arbitrary projections, is used.
